new_libraries.name: CANSignalStudioInterface
new_libraries.author: Terry Gould
new_libraries.sentence: Device-side interface library for CAN Signal Studio.
new_libraries.paragraph: Connects Arduino CAN firmware to the CAN Signal Studio webapp, exposing CAN traffic, device signals, device parameters, webapp transmitters, overrides, adaptive serial reporting, and session watchdog behavior. Requires ACANFD_SAME and CANMessageSignal.

new_libraries.name: NiusBus
new_libraries.author: dunknowcoding <NiusRobotLab>
new_libraries.sentence: Drivers for the CAN, CAN FD, RS-485 and Ethernet modules sold on AliExpress and Amazon.
new_libraries.paragraph: MCP2515 and MCP2518FD CAN, MAX485-family RS-485 with Modbus RTU, W5500 Ethernet with sockets and DHCP, ENC28J60 raw frames, and WIZnet/USR serial bridges. One API per module category, per-bus error codes and lost-packet statistics, no dynamic allocation, and a 48-board catalog keyed by the silkscreen. Runs on AVR, megaAVR, SAMD, ESP32 and Renesas RA4.

library.name: iotsa
library.author: Jack Jansen <Jack.Jansen@cwi.nl>
library.sentence: An Internet Of Things Server Architecture for ESP8266.
library.paragraph: Library/application framework that allows easy creation of web servers and REST servers. Optional modules provide access control, clock synchronisation, over-the-air programming, static document storage and retrieval and more. Add your own modules to access hardware.
